RELIC · Your entries belong to you.
https://relicjournalapp.com


This is your Relic journal.

Every day with an entry is its own text file. The files are sorted into folders by year and month, for example:

2026/10/2026-10-09.md

You can open them with any text editor, even without the Relic app.

How a file is built:

- At the very top, between two lines of three dashes (---), you find the date and when the entry was created and last changed.
- Below that is your text. It is written in Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, and lists with a dash at the start of a line.
- Photos are stored as JPEG files next to the entry (for example 2026-10-09_1.jpg). At the end of the text they are listed again after the line <!-- relic:photos --> so that other programs can show them.

Tip: Back up this folder regularly, for example to a computer or the cloud.


Relic saves your entries as plain files that you can still read in 30 years – even if the app no longer exists.
More about Relic: https://relicjournalapp.com
